text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A glorious victory in the Takarazuka 
Kinen! Biwa Hayahide has reached the top.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Considering her upcoming race schedule: 
Narita Brian would likely achieve the 
Classic Triple Crown, then head toward the 
Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Together with her Trainer, Biwa Hayahide 
decided to aim for the Tenno Sho (Autumn), 
partly to further hone her speed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way home, the Trainer notices that 
Biwa Hayahide is deeply exhausted. The 
Trainer wonders anxiously what they can do 
to help.
